items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 163:1
items.html: (To the question) It cannot be imagined that the NHY of Ima should be without the NHY of Aba, as the Rav said, page 950, Item 156, see there. And what he said — that only the NHY of Ima clothe in the Nukva — means the NHY of Ima from the Mochin of the Mazal of AB, when Ima is entirely BON, namely BON of Aba and BON of Ima. And the aspect of the BON of Aba is discerned as coming in the NHY of Aba. (Item 207).
